name: plan-hygiene
summary: Enforce message hygiene in check; commit via stdin
body:
R4 rejects multi-line summaries, NUL bytes, and Isomer-Change lines
smuggled into summary/body — the latter passed check, then corrupted
identity parsing on the materialized commit. The commit message now
reaches commit-tree via stdin: -m in argv died on ARG_MAX for large
bodies after check had promised success. SKILL.md documents the new
rules for plan-writing agents.
